card.name: Numbers after day, cycle or week
card.fires_on: A number (often 2, 4, 5 or a teen digit) right after Day, Cycle, Week or bar, marking a later start point in a schedule. It fires on the later number, not on 1.

modes.label: Later cycle or week start
modes.description: The number after Cycle or Week saying when a drug starts or changes, after an initial dose.
modes.example: Starting with cycle <<2>>, rituximab intravenous treatment

modes.label: Second digit of day number
modes.description: The last digit of a two-digit day, such as day 15, in a treatment timeline.
modes.example: on or before day 1<<5>> of induction chemotherapy

modes.label: Non-drug numbering
modes.description: Numbers in sheet-music bar counts or curriculum codes.

card.plain: It marks the number in a schedule that says which later day, week or cycle something begins.
